legal_context: HB60 (2026) narrowed the factors the State Engineer can weigh on water-right applications; only the Legislature can change that.
County moratoria are capped at 180 days.
MIDA holds land-use jurisdiction at Stratos, so Box Elder County's moratorium does not cover it.
Net change against current land use (EO 2026-03 principle) needs the baseline consumptive use of the converted water rights. That is the first data request to the Division of Water Rights.
